description:
A local-first knowledge base using plain Markdown files.

Tolaria is an open-source, local-first knowledge base with block-based editing, note relationships, Git integration, and AI model provider connections.
New Features
- 🩼 Stuck 2027.7.31 installs can update again — The future-dated 2027.7.31 build now accepts current stables, so those apps can move forward without a manual reinstall.
Improvements
- 🎨 Clearer dark-mode selection — Selected text stays readable in the dark editor instead of disappearing into the background.
- 📄 Table of contents keeps tildes — Headings with ~ stay intact in the TOC and still jump to the right place.
- 🖼️ Image renames stay in sync — Renaming an attached image updates the note so the picture does not break.
- 🪟 Windows note titles keep their path — Windows title and wikilink paths no longer get rewritten into the wrong shape.
- 🤖 Codex Safe matches current CLI — Safe mode launches on current Codex versions instead of failing on a retired approval flag.
- 📋 Steadier lists and IME — Nested lists keep their indent, slash commands reopen after composition, and the AI placeholder stays out of the way while you type.
Stability and Fixes
- Recovered leftover 2027.* installs so the next real 2026.x update can land without another version trap.
- Stopped stale editor uploads from writing the wrong file, and skipped Windows recycle metadata during vault scans.
- Isolated scripted HTML block previews and rejected invalid raw-editor cursor positions.
- Kept AI chat focus after switching apps, honored the default vault you picked, and expanded MCP tilde paths.
- Honored parent-repo gitignore rules and kept rename detection from blocking the editor.

Stable release — manually promoted from main
Includes macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows x64, and Linux x64 bundles
Built from 1fbd30d8 on 2026-08-28
